overview:
**Very High fire danger today, with critically low humidity (9%) and high ERC/BI (94–98%) pushing the area toward Extreme by Thursday.**
- Danger climbs to Extreme August 7 and holds through August 11 as ERC rises to 96–98% and fuels stay bone-dry.
- A Red Flag Warning is in effect today until 8:00 PM MDT for gusty winds and low humidity.
- Watchout status: 4 of 7 local thresholds met (ERC, BI, min and max RH) — heightened fire behavior potential.
- Stage 2 Fire Restrictions are in effect in unincorporated Montrose County starting on July 1, 2026; Ouray County implemented Stage 2 restrictions for all unincorporated areas effective June 28, 2026; Gunnison County is currently in Stage 2 Fire Restrictions, with no open burning or campfires allowed.
- Nearby: the Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is 39,507 acres and 72% contained; the Elk Fire near Lake City is 2,406 acres and 47% contained, per today's federal incident report.
